experiment_data.hypothesis: Reverse KL (mode-seeking, KL(p_sparse||p_dense)) produces different sparsity patterns than forward KL (mode-covering); mode-seeking may concentrate probability mass on fewer but more important neurons, potentially improving downstream at cost of PPL
